lines.text: Sunlight spills across the kitchen. Steam rises from a pot.
@maya_front lifts the lid and breathes in the steam.
She dips a wooden spoon into the soup.
She tastes it. A slow nod.
A smile spreads across her face.
Now that's exactly what I wanted.

writes.note: I drafted a short kitchen scene from your line, ending on one spoken line.

reply.rationale: Expanded the one-line action into a single-location 15 s scene with a slugline, five beats and one six-word line, about 14.4 s by the length rule.
